reading.title: A Message From Abroad
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述 Tim 的澳大利亚路线，而是换成一个表姐从加拿大发来的现代远距离更新：她已经在国外工作了一段时间，已经去过一些地方，接下来还要继续出发。重点练习 present perfect 作为“人生状态更新”。
passage: I have just received a long message from my cousin Anna in Canada. She is an engineer and is working for a small firm in Vancouver. She has been there for four months. In her message, she sent photos of the harbour, a snowy park, and a quiet island. She has already visited several different places near the city. Last week she bought a second-hand bicycle and has gone to Victoria for the weekend. She will soon take a train through the mountains to Calgary. Anna had never been abroad before, so every new street, station, and map line feels exciting to her. When I read her message, my own town suddenly felt connected to a much larger world.

questions.question: Who sent the update, and where is she?
options: Anna sent it from Canada.
Tim sent it from Australia.
Anna sent it from a town near the narrator's home.
A teacher sent it from a school trip.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文开头说 My cousin Anna has just sent me a long message from Canada。

questions.question: How long has Anna been in Vancouver?
options: For one week.
For four months.
For six years.
For only one day.
questions.explanation_zh: 文中说 She has been there for four months，说明这个状态从过去持续到现在。

questions.question: What has Anna already visited?
options: Only one shopping mall near her office.
Several different places near Vancouver.
Alice Springs, Darwin, and Perth.
The narrator's own town.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 She has already visited several different places near the city。

questions.question: What will Anna soon do?
options: She will soon return home and stop travelling.
She will soon buy an Australian car.
She will soon take a train through the mountains to Calgary.
She will soon move to the narrator's town.
questions.explanation_zh: will soon 后面写的是 take a train through the mountains to Calgary。

questions.question: Why does the trip feel exciting to Anna?
options: Because she dislikes every new place.
Because she is reading an old letter at home.
Because she has finished all her travel plans.
Because she has never been abroad before.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾说 Anna had never been abroad before，所以新的街道、车站和地图路线都让她觉得 exciting。

writing.intro_zh: 今天的仿写抓住 Lesson 4 的五个“远方人生更新”句型：刚收到某人的消息、在某地待了多久、已经去过哪里、已经去了某地还没回来，以及第一次出国带来的新鲜感。

patterns.title: have just received ... from ...
patterns.source: I have just received a letter from my brother, Tim.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 have just received...from... 写一条刚到的消息、邮件、照片或电话更新。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：你刚刚收到某个远方亲友、同学或老师发来的消息。
patterns.sample: I have just received a voice message from my aunt in Canada.
patterns.tip_zh: have just received 强调“刚收到”；from 后面写消息来自谁。

patterns.title: has been there for ...
patterns.source: He has been there for six months.
patterns.focus_zh: has been there for... 表示某人从过去到现在一直在那个地方。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：某人现在在外地或国外，并且已经在那里待了一段时间。
patterns.sample: My cousin is in Vancouver, and she has been there for four months.
patterns.tip_zh: there 指前面已经提到的地点；for 后面接一段时间。

patterns.title: has already visited ...
patterns.source: He has already visited a great number of different places.
patterns.focus_zh: has already visited... 把“到现在为止已经完成的旅行经历”说出来。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：某人到现在已经参观或去过几个地方。
patterns.sample: She has already visited three different places near the city.
patterns.tip_zh: already 放在 has 后面，visited 后面接去过的地方。

patterns.title: has gone to ...
patterns.source: He has gone to Alice Springs.
patterns.focus_zh: has gone to... 表示某人已经去了某地，现在不在原来的地方或还没回来。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：某人已经去了一个地方，并说明他/她稍后会做什么或回来。
patterns.sample: My brother has gone to the airport and will call me later.
patterns.tip_zh: 不要把 has gone to 和 has been to 混在一起；这里强调人已经出发去了那里。

patterns.title: has never been abroad before
patterns.source: My brother has never been abroad before.
patterns.focus_zh: has never been abroad before 表示过去到现在都没有过出国经历，所以这次是第一次。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：某人以前从未出过国，所以这次旅行、学习或工作让他/她很兴奋。
patterns.sample: My sister has never been abroad before, so this trip feels exciting to her.
patterns.tip_zh: before 放在句末很自然；后半句可以解释为什么这件事让人 excited。
